notes.title: 1.6.0.1版本更新说明
notes.content:

notes.title: Common question —— Language setting
notes.content:
“We love this game! It is awesome! But I can't understand what does it say?!”
 We got many comments about the problem of the language setting. 
 Our developers have tried to fix it many times, but some players asked that the game language settings are not synchronized with the steam system. so we decided to write a tutorial for our warmheartrd and friendly players.

Please follow steps to change the language type: 
1. Setting（设置/ゲームの設定）
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38531436/b4c8d2bd94d58ea9c0d28329335eda458aa0c520.jpg 
2. Language（语言/言語） and here you can choose 简中/ 繁中/ English / Japanese(日本语)
3. save(保存)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38531436/f4e75a5479a369e39072a1bdbd1e77f419d98b42.jpg

or check out here [url=]https://twitter.com/Hlxm3/status/1322724037672402945

 More information and updates will be posted on our official twitter and discord. Please follow NeverBreakUp official twitter and discord community.
 Twitter: NeverBreakUp_ISVR@Hlxm3

notes.title: 'NeverBreakup' Coming: Get 'NB' Free Demo!
notes.content:
The long-awaited STEAM Game Festival Autumn Edition is coming soon. The NB dev team has also prepared some big gifts for all players. Please enjoy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38531436/0fe000e847a8e7dd12ef40f2a08917d7e62f4d3e.jpg

  Gift 1: Updated New Demo 

The demo has been available on Sep 27th! Now you can enjoy it in advance! What has been updated in this demo? 


-Add 5 characters —— you can be whatever you want to be

-Add 10 accessories ——you are the most dazzling and fashion guy

-Support high/low image quality settings

-Support Online Mode & Race Mode —— 2020 online party

-Add 2 new maps ——more challenging

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38531436/2c07193103fc7d000fa3728f60768746b5518231.jpg

Gift 2: Bug Repair + Experience Optimization




-Modify the penetration problem after the characters fall underwater or on ground

-Modify the problem of sub player grabbing box movement delay

-Modify the button failure problem when the character grabs the ground and switches the state

-Modify the problem of the resurrection point offset after the death

-Modify the roles moving problem when opening the menu in the game
